title: 真实并行分支结果：failFast保留根因，取消分支不冒充失败或成功，未启动不伪绿
body:
## 操作任务
实现run_branches(jobs,parallelism=2,fail_fast=True,timeout=5)。每个job只有唯一id和直接执行的argv，按输入顺序返回branches，字段id/state/returncode/stdout/stderr/reason。state仅success、failed、aborted、not_started；正常非零退出是failed，因同伴失败取消是aborted/peer_failed，排队未启动保持not_started/None返回码。首个已观察到的失败后停止启动分支，取消并回收自有会话进程组（包括忽略TERM的孙进程），保留失败原码和部分日志；取消前先观察所有自然结束。fail_fast=False继续剩余任务但整体仍失败。超时整体timed_out、在跑分支aborted/timeout；正常整体success或failed。启动失败failed/spawn_error。先校验所有任务，重复或非法id、含NUL argv拒绝，parallelism整数1..8、timeout有限0..30秒，1..16个任务。不调用shell，不更改调用者进程组，不把未执行任务记成功。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Linux非root独立子进程、会话和进程组，验证2路并行、排队、真实退出7/9、TERM忽略后的KILL、实际孙进程不再运行及输出保留。此题是CI本地执行适配器的结果契约，不运行Jenkins控制器、CPS或Remoting，也不声称完整复现Jenkins特定版本的中断状态传播。程序均为自有有界测试负载；不是阻止恶意子进程setsid逃逸的安全沙箱，不运行构建或镜像操作。真实平台还应验证插件取消回执和远程agent退出。原008考查分片覆盖/退出码汇总，046考查外部部署取消回执，本题新增本地并发取消与四种分支状态及排队边界。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 说明平台语义而非只列发布通用步骤
把证据绑定具体身份、输入与执行路径
检查拒绝、取消和部分完成的结果

conversion.original_title: 并行流水线启用failFast时，怎样交付已失败、被中止与未开始分支的结果契约？

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,json,os,pathlib,signal,sys,tempfile,time
print("NATIVE_LINUX_READY",flush=True)
import task
print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: fail-fast branch result and owned process cleanup",flush=True)
def alive(pid):
    try:return pathlib.Path("/proc",str(pid),"stat").read_text().split(") ",1)[1].split()[0]!="Z"
    except FileNotFoundError:return False
def assert_dead(pids):
    until=time.monotonic()+0.7
    while any(alive(p) for p in pids) and time.monotonic()<until:time.sleep(0.01)
    assert not any(alive(p) for p in pids),"owned descendant survived cancellation"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
    root=pathlib.Path(temp);worker=root/"worker.py"
    worker.write_text("""
import json,os,pathlib,signal,subprocess,sys,time
mode,path=sys.argv[1:];path=pathlib.Path(path)
if mode=="hold":
 signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIG_IGN)
 child=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"-c","import signal,time;signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIG_IGN);time.sleep(20)"])
 path.write_text(json.dumps([os.getpid(),child.pid]))
 print("partial-held-output",flush=True)
 time.sleep(20)
elif mode=="fail":
 until=time.monotonic()+2
 while not path.exists() and time.monotonic()<until:time.sleep(.005)
 assert path.exists()
 print("root cause",file=sys.stderr,flush=True);sys.exit(7)
elif mode=="success":
 path.write_text("executed")
 print("branch-ok",flush=True)
elif mode=="exit":
 print("natural-failure",file=sys.stderr,flush=True);sys.exit(9)
""")
    def job(name,mode,path):return {"id":name,"argv":[sys.executable,str(worker),mode,str(path)]}
    pids_path=root/"pids.json";never=root/"never"
    jobs=[job("running","hold",pids_path),job("broken","fail",pids_path),job("queued","success",never)]
    original=copy.deepcopy(jobs);started=time.monotonic()
    try:
        r=task.run_branches(jobs,parallelism=2,fail_fast=True,timeout=4)
        assert jobs==original and time.monotonic()-started<3
        assert r["status"]=="failed" and [b["id"] for b in r["branches"]]==["running","broken","queued"]
        held,broken,queued=r["branches"]
        assert held["state"]=="aborted" and held["reason"]=="peer_failed" and held["returncode"]<0 and "partial-held-output" in held["stdout"]
        assert broken["state"]=="failed" and broken["returncode"]==7 and "root cause" in broken["stderr"] and broken["reason"] is None
        assert queued["state"]=="not_started" and queued["returncode"] is None and queued["reason"]=="peer_failed" and not never.exists()
        assert_dead(json.loads(pids_path.read_text()))
    finally:
        if pids_path.exists():
            for pid in json.loads(pids_path.read_text()):
                try:os.kill(pid,signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError:pass
    print("NATIVE_FAILFAST_FAILED_ABORTED_NOT_STARTED_DISTINCT_AND_DESCENDANTS_TERMINATED",flush=True)
    a=root/"a";b=root/"b"
    r=task.run_branches([job("failure","exit",a),job("after","success",b)],parallelism=1,fail_fast=False,timeout=3)
    assert r["status"]=="failed" and [x["state"] for x in r["branches"]]==["failed","success"] and b.read_text()=="executed"
    r=task.run_branches([job("one","success",a),job("two","success",b)],parallelism=2,timeout=3)
    assert r["status"]=="success" and all(x["state"]=="success" and x["returncode"]==0 for x in r["branches"])
    pids2=root/"timeout-pids.json"
    try:
        r=task.run_branches([job("slow","hold",pids2),job("pending","success",never)],parallelism=1,timeout=0.5)
        assert r["status"]=="timed_out" and r["branches"][0]["state"]=="aborted" and r["branches"][0]["reason"]=="timeout" and r["branches"][1]["state"]=="not_started" and not never.exists()
        assert_dead(json.loads(pids2.read_text()))
    finally:
        if pids2.exists():
            for pid in json.loads(pids2.read_text()):
                try:os.kill(pid,signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError:pass
    r=task.run_branches([{"id":"missing","argv":[str(root/"no-such-command")]},job("queued","success",never)],parallelism=1)
    assert r["status"]=="failed" and r["branches"][0]["reason"]=="spawn_error" and r["branches"][1]["state"]=="not_started" and not never.exists()
    for bad in [[job("dup","success",a),job("dup","success",b)],[{"id":"bad","argv":["x\x00y"]}]]:
        try:task.run_branches(bad)
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError("invalid branches accepted")
print("NATIVE_FAILFAST_FALSE_ALL_SUCCESS_TIMEOUT_SPAWN_ERROR_VALIDATION_AND_NO_FALSE_GREEN",flush=True)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
